boe.main_risk: UK remains more defensive-yield than growth leadership

boj.main_risk: Japan exposure can be volatile if yen/yield repricing accelerates

ecb.index_implication: Europe stays on the board, but not as automatic capital
ecb.likely_direction: policy support can help Europe only if earnings and price confirmation improve
ecb.main_risk: Europe catch-up fails if global growth or currency support weakens

fed.index_implication: prefer quality and confirmed leadership over weak breadth
fed.likely_direction: hold-to-ease path, but timing remains data-dependent
fed.main_risk: real-rate repricing pressures small caps, EM and speculative beta

pboc.main_risk: China and EM rallies can fail without durable policy credibility

EUM.reason: Dollar pressure is not strong enough to activate EM inverse readiness.

RWM.reason: Small-cap breadth remains weak versus SPY.

geopolitical_regime.portfolio_implication: Treat oil, rates and defense/geopolitical shocks as risk filters for small caps, EM and Europe.

australia_large_cap.reason: Australia is commodity and China-sensitive; require confirmation when USD or China stress rises.

brazil_large_cap.reason: Brazil needs commodity support and a friendlier dollar backdrop before promotion.

em_broad.reason: A weaker dollar backdrop would improve EM timing.

europe_large_cap.reason: Europe remains a diversification candidate, but price confirmation is still required.

indonesia_large_cap.reason: Indonesia adds ASEAN domestic-demand beta but remains liquidity and USD-sensitive.

japan_equities.reason: Japan remains a valid non-U.S. developed diversification lane, subject to currency/yield volatility.

mexico_large_cap.reason: Mexico adds nearshoring exposure, but still requires price confirmation versus broad EM.

saudi_large_cap.reason: Saudi exposure is energy and domestic-reform sensitive; use as a specialist Middle East lane.

south_korea_large_cap.reason: Korea adds semiconductor/export-cycle exposure, but needs global tech and currency confirmation.

taiwan_large_cap.reason: Taiwan is a high-quality semiconductor lane but carries supply-chain and geopolitical concentration risk.

us_equal_weight.reason: Equal weight is the cleanest test of U.S. breadth improvement beyond mega-cap concentration.

us_min_vol_factor.reason: Minimum volatility becomes more useful if risk appetite deteriorates.

us_quality_factor.reason: Quality can preserve U.S. exposure while reducing weaker balance-sheet beta.

us_small_cap.reason: Small-cap breadth and real-rate conditions remain insufficient for broad risk expansion.

us_tech_leadership.reason: Nasdaq leadership remains the cleanest long-side index impulse.

us_value_factor.reason: Value needs evidence of broadening, rates stability and cyclical participation.

portfolio_implications: Do not treat narrow U.S. leadership as full global breadth confirmation.
Keep IWM and EM funding conditional on breadth, dollar and real-rate improvement.
Keep defensive / inverse candidates separate from the long-side opportunity board.

region_implications.Korea / Taiwan: Semiconductor supply-chain leadership can support the AI/tech regime, but geopolitical and currency risk must be explicit.
